notes: Bookey voice evaluation set. 'tts' items are narration lines (judged by listening); 'stt' items are learner questions (scored by WER against the Latin-script reference). Tanglish is written in Latin letters exactly as the learner sees it.

tts.text: Vanakkam! Innaiku namma Python variables pathi kathukkaporom.
React-la useState hook use pannumbodhu, state update aana component re-render aagum.
Oru function-ku input kudutha, adhu oru output return pannum. Simple-a sollanumna, idhu oru machine maadhiri.
Indha loop moonu thadava run aagum, ovvoru thadavaiyum i value onnu onna increase aagum.
Database-la SQL JOIN use panna, rendu tables-la irukkura matching rows-a onna serkkalaam.
Machine learning model training data-la irundhu patterns learn pannum, appuram pudhu input-ku prediction kudukkum.
Super! Neenga correct-a pannitinga. Ippo konjam kashtamaana example paarkalaam.
Error vandha bayappadaadheenga. Traceback-a keezha irundhu mela padinga, mistake enga nu theriyum.
API call panna, server oru JSON response anuppum. Adha namma parse panni screen-la kaattuvom.
Recursion na, oru function thannaiye thirumba call panradhu. Base case illana, adhu mudiyave mudiyaadhu.
Git commit pannadhukku munnaadi, git status paathu enna files maarirukku nu check pannunga.
List mutable, tuple immutable. Adhaavadhu tuple-a create panna apram maatha mudiyaadhu.
Indha diagram-la paarunga: browser request anuppudhu, server process pannudhu, response thirumba varudhu.
Neural network-la ovvoru layer-um konjam konjama features-a extract pannum.
Ippo neengale try pannunga. Code-la x value-a 25 nu maathi, Run button-a press pannunga.
Welcome back! Today we will learn how variables store values in Python.
A dictionary maps each key to a value, so lookups stay fast even when the data grows.
Great work. Now let's run the code and see what the print statement shows.
Gradient descent nudges every weight a little in the direction that reduces the loss.
If the request fails, the server returns a 404 status code instead of the page.
